# SYNESIS_E103 — Error

## Description

Concepts `name_a` and `name_b` collide (same identity after Unicode normalization).

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The concept `name_b` has the same identity as `name_a`
  (in `a.syn`): the names look equal, but one of them uses accented
  letters in decomposed form (letter + combining accent). Synesis treats
  them as the same concept. Rewrite one of the names, or merge the two blocks.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **IdentityCollision**: `first_name`, `second_name`, `first_file`
